description: BFP8 weights on every layer (no BFP4 exceptions) + BFP4 LoFi LM head

groups.o: o_proj (row-parallel, decode all-reduce / prefill reduce-scatter after it)
groups.gate_up: gate_proj + up_proj (FF1 + FF3, column-parallel; prefill packed copy uses the same dtype)

activations.decode_intermediates_note: decode matmul outputs kept on chip (qkv, gate_up, the MLP product, norm outputs) are BF16; the o_proj and down outputs that feed the decode all-reduce take ccl.decode_all_reduce (BFP8)

logits.softcap: 30 * tanh(x / 30) on device into the persistent BF16 logits buffer

sampling.note: on-device two-level top-32 per chip over the vocab-sharded BF16 logits; greedy = lowest-id argmax

selection.selected_from: b0_lmh4_lofi (the stage-9 selection) without its BFP4 weight exceptions (layers 13-26 / 35-39 gate_up, 13-24 down, 13-25 qkv / o, 24 / 36 / 37 qkv), after GPQA Diamond scored 66.7 against the 74.2 same-protocol GPU reference
selection.accuracy_check: teacher forcing on GPQA reasoning traces (thinking on, 8 traces, 8000 positions) against HF bf16 on the CPU: KL(HF || TT) x1000 74 -> 28, top-1 0.925 -> 0.952, top-1 misses where HF p >= 0.9: 12 -> 0; HF bf16 vs fp32 reference: 0.3, 0.994, 0. A CPU emulation of the block-float weights on the HF model gives KL x1000 30 for the BFP4 exceptions and 1.0 for BFP8 everywhere
selection.speed: local vLLM 128/128: 1 user 12.6 -> 13.2 ms/token, 32 users 1383 -> 1332 tok/s

previous_selection.selected_from: re-selection in the vLLM stage (doc/datatype_sweep/README.md 'Stage-9 re-selection'): the previous selection gu4all_down4_13_46_o4in_lmh4 fails the recall set (11 / 14). b0_lmh4_lofi is selected by scripts/aggregate.py's rule: the fastest config that passes the token gate, the v5 screen, the full-context check and the recall set, where accepted configs with overlapping TF repetition ranges are tied and the tie goes to the fewest matmul math-fidelity passes (b0_lmh4_hifi2 is bit-identical and tied; same-session token-out LoFi 12.261-12.262 ms vs HiFi2 12.264-12.265 ms, logs/stage9/perf_token_out_*_ab*.json)
previous_selection.token_gate: min(run_prefill_check, run_teacher_forcing) on bringup/references/gemma4_12b_it_aime24_chat.refpt: top-1 >= 0.90, top-5 >= 0.98, top-100 = 1.00

selection.consumed_by: tt/precision.py PrecisionConfig.load(None) in Gemma4Model.__init__ (build_generator and every adapter built on them); Gemma4Model verifies the built model against it
